**Triage** — graded `p3`, `i18n`, `pm:queue`, routed `domain:engine` (`packages/platform-objects` is that lane). Applied and read back first.

## Both stale leaves confirmed at `origin/main` `c616c2c`

| leaf | zh-CN | source (`spec/src/ui/dashboard.form.ts`) |
|---|---|---|
| `dashboard.sections.layout.description` (`:898`) | 「栅格与响应式」 | `:21` `'Grid sizing and refresh cadence.'` |
| `dashboard.fields.header.helpText` (`:939`) | 「标题、操作按钮与筛选」 | `:27` `'Dashboard header config (title, subtitle, actions)'` |

Your guess that the second "looks like the same vintage" holds — both drifted the same way.

## ⭐ The measurement that reframes your part 2: es-ES is NOT stale

`es-ES.metadata-forms.generated.ts` for the same leaf reads:

```
layout: { label: "Diseño", description: "Tamaño de cuadrícula y cadencia de actualización." }
```

"Grid sizing and refresh cadence" — **es-ES followed the source move; zh-CN did not.**

That changes the shape of the class question. Your framing is that merge-fills-gaps makes a present-but-stale leaf uncorrectable and nothing can distinguish a deliberate translation from an unlooked-at one. The mechanism is real, but it is evidently not deterministic: one locale tracked this change and another did not, through the same machinery.

⇒ **The lead for part 2 is that difference.** Before asking whether `*.source-hashes.generated.ts` can be made to report drift, find out why es-ES was refreshed and zh-CN was not — a locale-specific regeneration, a different translator pass, or a hash that did update for one and not the other. Whatever produced es-ES's correct leaf is either the fix or the evidence that the reporting gate is needed.

⚠️ Two more facts for whoever takes it:

- Source-hash files exist for **three** locales — `es-ES`, `ja-JP`, `zh-CN` — each with both a `.generated.ts` and a hand `.ts`. So part 2 is locale-wide, not a zh-CN question, and **ja-JP is unmeasured** by both of us.
- **`scripts/check-i18n-stale-fill.mjs` already exists** and is wired as `check:i18n-stale-fill`. Part 2 may not be "build a reporter" but "why is the existing one silent here". ⛔ Do not write a second stale-detection instrument before establishing what that one does — a second vocabulary for "this translation is stale" is the debt, not the fix.

## Scope ruled

**Part 1 only, and it is dispatchable now:** correct the two zh-CN leaves to match their sources. Two strings.

⛔ Do not hand-edit `zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` if it is regenerated — establish the producer first (`packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` is the likely entry) and fix at the source, or the next generation undoes it. This is the same trap #14565 names for `_index.md`.

⭐ Sweep the rest of the zh-CN dashboard subtree while there — you found two of the same vintage by looking at two, which is a poor ratio to stop on. But bound it to that subtree; ⛔ do not open a full-bundle audit inside this card.

**Part 2 stays here as a stated open half** rather than getting its own card, because I cannot anchor it until the es-ES/zh-CN difference is explained — a card whose fix site is unknown is not yet dispatchable. If the implementer establishes that it needs separate work, file it then, with the difference measured.

## On the filing

Separating the instance from the class in the body, and refusing to fix platform strings from the renderer side, is the right discipline in both directions — it is the same producer/consumer rule #14586 turns on.
